455.ateret-zekenim/1:_: One may not knead, etc. One should point the lamed in shelanu with kamatz and not patach, for otherwise it speaks of him alone like u-lanu in Gibeah (so too in his Shulchan Aruch). If one kneaded, it is forbidden only in eating; but in benefit it is permitted immediately before it comes to leavening. Even where it is impossible, one should not permit even b'dieved since there is concern for becoming chametz — unlike what Shulchan Aruch wrote to be lenient in a time of pressure. However, water drawn while it was still day and left overnight, or drawn after the beginning of the night and left overnight, is permitted even l'chatchila.
455.ateret-zekenim/5:_: It is customary not to, etc. But after baking it is certainly permitted to scrape the faces of the matzot with salt water and return them to the oven as they do on chol ha'moed with salt water and eggs; and specifically on chol ha'moed it is permitted to scrape, but on the first two nights it is forbidden; and even to dip them in salt that the Yerushalmi permitted as below siman 475 — people refrain; and in this too there is concern because of do not forsake, etc. Nevertheless in this too b'dieved one need not be concerned even if he scraped after baking in salt water and eggs and spices as on chol ha'moed, for this scraping is no worse than spices with which matzah was baked through which one fulfills the obligation of matzah (my teacher in Bach).
455.baer-heitev/1:ב: Not harmful. And even if they stood in the sun. Beit Yosef and Magen Avraham.
455.baer-heitev/1:ג: To cover them. Specifically an earthenware or wood vessel and the like — covering helps; but if they are in a glass vessel, covering does not help. Kaf HaChayim — see there.
455.baer-heitev/1:ה: Iron. One takes new or clean iron and hangs it on a cord in the water, but one does not put his hand in the water, for the hand heats the water. In the rest of the year one places salt or a seal. Darkei Moshe, Magen Avraham. Taz wrote: it appears to me that on other nights, if one did not place iron in them to guard from the tekufah, one may pour them out if one can easily be without that water — which is not so with these waters of matzah of the mitzvah: it is forbidden to pour out, for it appears contemptuous of the verse "a keeper of a mitzvah knows no evil" — see there; and Kaf HaChayim practice filtering water — Maharil. Mateh Moshe wrote one should not take a vessel to draw water that had honey or fruit juice in it, for fruit juice with water hastens to become chametz as siman 462. (And likewise one should not take a copper vessel — Magen Avraham — and I have not seen practice so.) It appears to me that through boiling it is permitted. Magen Avraham.
455.baer-heitev/2:א: In a cistern (susternah). This is what they call in Talmudic language a pit — water collected in a building in the ground where the building separates it from the ground and it is also covered above, so it is as if they are drawn; one should not compare this to what we call in foreign language ar'ar kastin, for although it is covered above, one may not draw from it to use close to drawing because every hour and moment flows into it from the river. However, if one wishes to leave them overnight like other water and draw at its time, it is permitted to draw under the pipe or what they call in foreign language ar'ar, like from a river or a well drawn from it; and likewise from the kastin itself if it is covered. Kaf HaChayim.
455.baer-heitev/3:א: Its copper rim. Rashi explained the rim is thick and there is no difference between copper and earthenware — Magen Avraham. Hagahot Maimoniyot wrote R' Yitzchak the White would not allow kneading in water that was in a copper vessel that heats the water — there was an incident and other rabbis forbade likewise. However, practice is to knead in copper vessels, as in Knesset HaGedolah and Kaf HaChayim s.k. 10. Or Zaru'a wrote an incident came before my elders, may they rest in Eden: one placed mayim matzah in a warm winter room; he asked if the vessel was hot when they took from it; he said no — and permitted.
455.baer-heitev/3:ג: B'shogeg. And he has no other dough — Magen Avraham. Taz wrote on the first night one may rely so as not to nullify the positive mitzvah of eating matzah, but not other days — rather he eats other things. (And Kaf HaChayim implies the opposite for matzah of the mitzvah in any case one should not take it — see there.)
455.baer-heitev/5:א: Salt. But after baking it is certainly permitted to scrape the faces of the matzah in salt water and return them to the oven as on chol ha'moed. And specifically on chol ha'moed scraping is permitted, but on the first two nights it is forbidden — see Taz.
455.baer-heitev/6:א: With caraway. Kimmel in Ashkenaz language.
455.baer-heitev/6:ד: Lime. This is live lime; but lime in a wall that already dried and hardened like stone — it appears plainly it does not forbid. Shevut Yaakov part 2 siman 13.
455.beer-hagolah/1:ג: Rashi and Ba'al HaHalachot Gedolot and most of the poskim
455.beer-hagolah/2:א: Orchot Chayim in the name of the Ra'avad
455.beer-hagolah/4:_: Semag in the name of R' Yechiel and Semak
455.beer-hagolah/6:ב: Tur in the name of Rokeach; there 20; and pepper; and prohibition of spices — he wrote all of it in the name of the Ra'avad
455.beur-hagra/1:נ: One may not pour out. As written "a keeper of a mitzvah knows no evil" — and Taz.
455.beur-hagra/6:ב: Nevertheless. The Ra'avad in chapter 12 of Hilchot Ma'achalot Assurot forbids in cooked dishes that become chametz; and what is written in Menachot "seasoned," etc., and so in Tosefta and Yerushalmi chapter Kol Sha'ah — matzah seasoned is discussed when seasoning is after baking; but in Yerushalmi chapter 2 halachah 4 it is not so, for R' Simon in the name of R' Yehuda bar Levi said: that kezayit with which a person fulfills on the 15th of Nissan must not have liquid come into it, etc.; and it was taught: one fulfills with seasoned matzah even though it has no taste of grain — they thought to say seasoned means liquids; it was said seasoned means spiced; nuts — therefore permitted even before baking, for after baking rich matzah is not relevant; and as written siman 462 seif 4; and so Ra'avad in laws of matzah chapter 6 because of rich matzah it is forbidden.
455.chok-yaakov/1:י: New earthenware vessels, etc. In all books of Shulchan Aruch it is written thus in the name of Kol Bo, but I did not find it in his words. Magen Avraham wrote: Mateh Moshe wrote one should not take a vessel that had fruit juice, for fruit juice with water hastens to become chametz. (It appears to me through boiling it is permitted.) Also one should not take a copper vessel that heats — end quote; however I have seen practice kneading in copper troughs — end Magen Avraham. In truth one can distinguish: mayim shelanu require cooling, and in copper perhaps they do not cool — unlike for kneading; see gloss in minhagim forbidding drawing in copper too — so practice; b'dieved do not forbid — and so Ateret Zekenim siman 459; and so appears from what is written seif 3 on thick copper rim.
455.chok-yaakov/2:א: Cistern. This is what Talmud calls a pit — water collected in a building in the ground separated from the ground and covered above, as if drawn; not comparable to ar'ar kastin covered above — do not draw close to drawing because constantly flows from river; but if leaving overnight like other water, permitted to draw under pipe or ar'ar like river or well or kastin itself if covered.
455.chok-yaakov/3:ג: Lukewarm. That is, like warmth of saliva; Yerushalmi chapter Kol Sha'ah halachah 7: although in Menachot kneaded lukewarm and they guard lest they become chametz because priests are zealous — in matzah even priests should not knead lukewarm lest distinguish matzah from matzah — end quote; see Menachot 55a; explained in Tur and Beit Yosef: in benefit permitted for all even kneading in hot water.
455.eliyah-rabbah/1:_: [1] One may not knead, etc. I found our text points shelanu with kamatz under the lamed, not patach, lest it mean him alone like lanu in Gibeah — end quote.
455.eliyah-rabbah/6:_: [6] [Levush] It is a building, etc. Chok Yaakov wrote one should not compare to ar'ar kastin because constantly flows from river; however if one wishes to leave overnight, permitted to draw under pipe like kastin itself — end quote; requires slight analysis: also in cistern water always flows from depth.
455.kaf-hachayyim/1:_: (1) [Seif 1] One may knead only in mayim shelanu — even matzah not for the mitzvah, because of concern for leavening. Rashbatz in Ma'amar on chametz 30 and responsum part 2 siman 87; brought Birkei Yosef note 1, Kissei Eliyahu note 1, Sha'arei Teshuvah this section; also Rosh end chapter Kol Sha'ah and Maggid Mishneh chapter 5 law 11; Bach, Beit Yosef; Kol Bo 38a — so agreed geonim and most sages, not like R' Yitzchak Gikat; see Bach, Eliyah Rabbah note 1; also Raz note 1.
455.kaf-hachayyim/5:_: (5) Permitted to knead in water a gentile said casually is ours in his house — presumption of prohibition does not apply and it is d'rabbanan; stringent see 462. Maharil in responsum 21 siman 103; Birkei Yosef note 5. It appears certainly one does not fulfill with these on the 15th, for no guarding; also for other matzot concern — perhaps something leavening fell in; in pressure permit through filtering — Sha'arei Teshuvah there.
455.machatzit-hashekel/4:ד: And b'dieved Bach is lenient if drawn at night. This is called b'dieved.
455.magen-avraham/1:ב: Not harmful. And even if they stood in the sun (Beit Yosef, Eliyah Rabbah); siman 459 seif 65.
455.magen-avraham/1:ה: From rivers. Because the sun travels in Nissan days under the ground and therefore wells boil; but melting of snow and rain always boils.
455.magen-avraham/1:ו: And not from wells. Because the sun travels under the ground.
455.magen-avraham/1:ז: One may not pour out. For "a keeper of a mitzvah knows no evil."
455.magen-avraham/1:ט: Iron. One does not put his hand in the water, for the hand heats — only hang on a cord (Maharil); rest of year salt or seal (Hagahot Maimoniyot, Darkei Moshe). Practice filters water (Maharil). Mateh Moshe: do not take vessel that had honey or fruit juice — fruit juice with water hastens to become chametz siman 462. (Boiling permitted — it appears.) Also not in copper vessel that heats — end quote; however I have seen kneading in copper troughs — Semag see there.
455.magen-avraham/2:_: Cistern. Building separates from ground and covered above — as if drawn.
455.magen-avraham/3:ג: In time of pressure. Bach explained: if no other water, permitted to knead; disagreed with Shulchan Aruch; it appears Shulchan Aruch did not intend to permit except if kneaded b'dieved and no other dough — Rama refers to this; wrote even without pressure permit if transgressed b'shogeg, etc. — see above seif 1.
455.magen-avraham/5:_: One should forbid. Thus Darkei Moshe; per his words siman 462 even b'dieved forbid; Mordechai: eating salted matzah like eating chametz — end quote; it appears if a grain of salt fell in, if baked immediately permitted as siman 462; if because of heating, rely on all that little salt does not heat entire dough — b'dieved siman 91.
455.magen-avraham/6:ג: And pepper. Even one grain makes entire dough chametz; likewise a little lime (Darkei Moshe, Mahariv). It appears specifically kneaded into it; if fell on, remove and permitted. Ginger like pepper; possibly anise and saffron too. In hints it implies pepper permitted b'dieved; nevertheless do not be lenient — see above seif 65 regarding salt.
455.mishnah-berurah/1:א: (1) One may not knead, etc. — whether matzah of the mitzvah or other matzot.
455.mishnah-berurah/1:ג: (3) Whether river water — although not from springs and reasons above do not apply, nevertheless be stringent also to cool them because sun's heat by day warmed them somewhat.
455.mishnah-berurah/1:25: (25) Wooden vessel, etc. — likewise stone or coated earthenware (glazed); only if used only for water; if had fruit juice (all liquids except water for this law) beware drawing unless boiled first, for fruit juice mixed hastens to become chametz as siman 462; certainly forbid large barrels used for honey then washed for matzah in bakeries — absolute prohibition as fruit juice exudes. L'chatchila avoid copper even new — copper heats; b'dieved no concern even if water stood many days; even l'chatchila practice permits copper troughs — only beware drawing for water needs overnight cooling and in copper does not cool like other vessels.
455.mishnah-berurah/2:ב: (27) One should not be lenient, etc. — for we see water inside is not cold at all; one can say since building attached to ground, although paved, nevertheless heats from sun traveling under ground — therefore needs overnight like other waters unless pressure. When water does not flow under pavement; but if flows under pavement or constant pipe like ar'ar kastin always pouring from pipes — do not be lenient even in pressure, for water in building connects with ground water. Water in pool certainly not lenient even in pressure — not covered below only above — Peri Megadim.
455.mishnah-berurah/3:א: (29) In hot water — even if became lukewarm as below; even if completely cooled, some forbid kneading because once hot; some dispute and permit; rely on them in pressure or great loss if transgressed and kneaded much matzah.
455.mishnah-berurah/4:ב: (39) Knead with them — specifically if water mixed before kneading and nullified; putting one part in two in mayim shelanu is forbidden even b'dieved — study if mixed intentionally.
455.mishnah-berurah/5:א: (40) It is customary not to, etc. — because some say salt heats dough and thereby eases leavening.
455.mishnah-berurah/5:ב: (41) In matzah — before baking; after baking certainly permitted to scrape matzah faces in salt water and return to oven as on chol ha'moed; nevertheless for matzah of mitzvah on both nights be careful.
455.peri-megadim/4:_: Iron — Taz. Salt helps for tekufah — see Yoreh De'ah 116 end ch. 5 Ra'ah Chadash. In mayim shelanu forbidden to put our salt in them — fruit juice with water hastens to become chametz siman 462, 472 in Magen Avraham 7; explained there. Forbidden for gentile to draw for matzah of mitzvah — Peri Chadash: reason like preparing for mitzvah siman 462; b'dieved permitted; when drawing say for matzah of mitzvah — Kaf HaChayim notes 8, 9. And see Eliyah Rabbah in Magen Avraham note 16 from this. Iron or seal with cloth — implies sealing with cloth cannot harm as we find all engraved and sealed, etc. — see gloss 24 months; wooden vessel no concern — explained Magen Avraham note 10; Levush seif 7 requires study.

456.kaf-hachayyim/1:_: (1) [Seif 1] One may not knead a large dough for Pesach, etc. — because sages fixed measure: occupation with kneading, arranging does not save from leavening when larger than isaron; hand does not suffice even if zealous from kneading to baking without pause of mil — forbidden l'chatchila more than isaron. Raz note 1: even if splitting immediately to helpers — concern leavening at kneading and perhaps poor kneading leaving flour, cooks later. If small doughs later combined — forbidden, concern in arranging. Iggerot Moshe note 1; see below note 22.
456.kaf-hachayyim/3:_: (3) Now that women begin kneading and rolling, give to others to scrape and finish scribing and baking in sequence — since one lacks more than measure and large board, no concern kneading many measures one after another — so practice. Rashbatz Ma'amar on chametz 31; Eliyah Rabbah note 1.
456.peri-megadim/1:_: Leveled — Taz. In Menachot 87a: R' Meir — two isaron: one heaped, one leveled; Rabbanan — one isaron leveled per Rav Chisda; Rashi, Tosafot: between them only one isaron compressed flour from 43 eggs medium hen; other meal-offerings: vessel holds two-thirds isaron heaped one-third; high priest: vessel itself holds 43 eggs and fifth, no heaping; 90a all measures heaped except high priest's pressed into vessel per R' Meir per Rav Chisda — leveled means removal; see above; Rambam Hilchot Klei HaMikdash 1:16 ruled one isaron leveled like Rabbanan without explaining leveled — see Maggid Mishneh; truth follows R' Meir and halacha follows stam then stam; say heaped pressed in because leveled outside (actions: heaped, leveled, heaped, leveled, sealed); Rambam in Mishnah commentary this for R' Meir — heaped into that isaron while leveled as one isaron holds when heaped — needs explanation; appears as Beit Yosef: compressed flour holds more than loose — third view: two isaron in Gemara: one for high priest, one for all offerings, both vessel two-thirds plus heaping one-third; high priest's heaping outside lest fall — Rashi, Tosafot 87a — forced active pressing; say three disputes and this Mishnah for R' Meir per his way — forced. Rav Chisda per his view: R' Meir and Rabbanan all high priest leveled; Rabbanan one leveled for all; if Rabbanan one heaped for all and high priest heaped in — forced compressed flour — Mishnah all measures heaped except high priest necessarily heaped in — forced; Rambam Klei HaMikdash ruled so sometimes or found elsewhere. Rosh: challah measure 43 eggs grain ground much — needs heaping for omer from stalks; likewise rich meal-offering isaron fine flour — all measures heaped, high priest heaped in — no proof against Rosh; not corrupt explanation — Peri Chadash, Peri Megadim 6, Bach study. For law: flour only 43 eggs and fifth for challah and Pesach. Yoreh De'ah 324: author wrote measure not heaped — appears no warning needed; Pesach warning — say measure holds 43 leveled not two-thirds with heaping like high priest lest scatter below measure — Riva in Mordechai; forced Peri Chadash, Kaf HaChayim; Riva: do not heap Pesach measure because after isaron like high priest; what I did not sense: human cannot measure precisely; eggs vary — easy see Chullin 28b s.v. lefi. For challah add if can fulfill Tur, doubt Rosh challah 324; Pesach take compressed measure 43 eggs not more, take challah after in basket not heaped — all the more Pesach; see Magen Avraham note 2.
456.peri-megadim/2:ג: Related to note 1 in my barrel — one can say compressed, no concern for flour inside unlike other offerings lest flour remain and enter dish permissible to eat — see Darkei Moshe 2; understand.
456.turei-zahav/2:_: Permitted b'dieved. Measure of leavening is only mil pause; if left without occupation only l'chatchila concern hands insufficient for large dough — like somewhat idle — forbidden l'chatchila above measure; if one dough only, make with room for challah measure — no leavening concern for this bit (Beit Yosef in name of Sefer HaTerumah).

457.baer-heitev/1:ג: (3) In a basket. A vessel without receptacle — doubt if combines; covering with cloth counts as vessel and combines — so practice (Taz). Shlah: protest folding dough taking challah from two ends — take one end, one rolls at other end exposed. Custom separate from each dough (Darkei Moshe). Must be per custom of large doughs — Magen Avraham: one blessing suffices all if no unrelated speech between kneading. Now majority separate each dough, each woman blesses. Blessing: no difference Pesach and year (Darkei Moshe; Taz Yoreh De'ah 328). Derishah: reason saying on Pesach "terumat challah matzah from dough" — reason making challah first like matzah then throw to fire; Maharshal house burned without repair — Mateh Moshe; if challah fell in boiling food — besides mixture laws Yoreh De'ah 324, discuss chametz siman 454 seif 3. Kaf HaChayim in father-in-law's name: benefit or keep until after Pesach — see there.
457.chok-yaakov/1:ג: Good to bring doughs together. Do not leave dough folded when separating — take from one end, one arranges with roller at other end exposed (Shlah). Custom separate each dough (Darkei Moshe) — per custom large doughs as siman 456 above. Magen Avraham: one blessing if no unrelated speech; now majority separate, each woman blesses; make challah first like matzah then throw to fire; some burn without repair; if fell in dish — challah mixture Yoreh De'ah 324 and chametz siman 454 note 4.
457.chok-yaakov/1:ט: And from part did not take. Mateh Moshe, minhagim, Levush: if forgot from matzah of mitzvah doughs, wait until night to place whole on plate; when breaking second matzah for two for afikoman, place two whole and two broken in vessel to combine, cover, take small piece from broken, bless challah, keep for chol ha'moed, burn chol ha'moed. Better break small piece by day lest forget — anyway breaks without blessing at night — Levush; so practice not wait until night — dough from erev Yom Tov forbidden separate on Yom Tov siman 506; brother-in-law wondered permitting night Yom Tov — if forgot until night, for those not kneading challah measure together, no obligation erev — obligated now on Yom Tov through combination — permit separate Yom Tov though could combine erev (unlike kneading warm bread) — as Levush siman 506; nevertheless permit Yom Tov since not dipped until now — Beitzah 2a explicitly; thus answer Levush difficulty; if forgot, lenient more — Magen Avraham siman 506 note 10; also eat guarded matzah. Nevertheless what can separate before night without doubt, do not be lenient gratuitously.
457.chok-yaakov/2:א: It becomes chametz. Although holy and no bal yera'eh bal yimatzei — since if he wishes he redeems it — Pesachim 46; therefore Erev Pesach on Shabbos with chametz challah already ate chametz — cannot redeem, ate tevel retroactively (Yoreh De'ah 323); vows not asked on Shabbos if not Shabbos need — siman 341; no destruction needed since no bal yera'eh even breaking vessel — Pesachim 6a separated; although challah now d'rabbanan, d'oraisa bal yera'eh bal yimatzei — we hold d'oraisa nullification suffices — study. If minor kohen or kohen immersed for keri, may eat — below; at least press vessel.
457.chokhmat-shlomo/1:_: Seif 2: One should not call name until baked, etc. Gemara Pesachim 42b and R' Chananel: that foreskin — since obligation, bar kapparah; challenge: for Rabbah reverse — here lacking act, there not — for R' Chananel internal difficulty; say R' Chananel has hu'il only leniently, stringent too; proven there when not lacking act, stringent all say hu'il. Study from Makkot 13b: for R' Akiva if did not repent, liable keraitot now; why not answer perhaps repented — because hu'il; if repents not two wickednesses — lashes; hu'il stringent, not lacking act — Kiddushin: righteous even if wicked perhaps thought repentance; why not hu'il here — great question. In hu'il sugya R' Yehoshua: good of benefit not money; She'eilat Ya'avetz chametz: Bava Metzia proves R' Yehoshua holds good of benefit is money — I expanded elsewhere; now appears: R' Eliezer and R' Yehoshua dispute if good of benefit is money — not logic, whether Torah made it like money; one: since Torah gave him to separate, made like money; one: Torah did not. Chametz: like R' Eliezer — not in his possession, Torah made as if in possession; actual money Torah made as if possession — all year not in possession, Torah as if possession — actual money; benefit Torah made like money — acquired now; Torah did not make still as if possession — established; benefit not actually money — clear; study well. (Same seif) {Rama: if minor kohen who did not see keri or adult immersed for keri may bake challah for him.} See Magen Avraham Rivan, Darkei Moshe: less than nine; wrote: we say presumably no keri; if saw keri even day-old impure — Kaf HaChayim objected: under nine even if saw keri not impure — see my Niddah; now Rambam Terumot 7: minor who did not see keri, minor who did not see niddah blood — eat always without checking, presumption no impurity yet — therefore Rivan, Darkei Moshe until nine; Rambam must mean under nine; nevertheless wrote presumption — if known impurity, forbidden like adult tamei — Magen Avraham. Therefore Kaf HaChayim opposite — Rambam means distinction: impure others by touch not, but from his body tamei — clear proof. Study well. Now Rambam Tum'at Met 1:14: adult and minor become impure all impurities — "all" includes keri; not only met but all — gentiles and animals not; gezeirah gentiles like zavim; why zav here — only met? Must include zav in "all" — therefore minors impure all including keri from body — Magen Avraham. Forced: minor nine years — all impurities even day-old; if "all" includes keri from body — Magen Avraham. Forced under nine — Makkot 27 Rashi s.v. kohen katan: not impure from body; if immersed like kohen katan for keri — alternative; Bechorot 27 Leshonot Rashi — dispute Magen Avraham/Kaf HaChayim; under nine even keri not impure others — Leshonot Bach; Rosh challah agrees touch required; our master abbreviated — Tosafot Eruvin 46: in basket touch required for surrounding challah; Tur, Shulchan Aruch did not require touch here — we hold not from surrounding Yoreh De'ah 323; R' Yonatan in Semag: basket does not combine — Peri Megadim uncertain; appears no stringent b'dieved since Semag lenient air of vessel combines interior even above — Biur HaGra; study Yoreh De'ah 325.
457.eshel-avraham/2:א: It becomes chametz. Although holy and not his — since if he wishes redeems — Erev Pesach Shabbos chametz challah ate chametz — cannot redeem, ate tevel (Yoreh De'ah 323); vows not on Shabbos if not need — 341; no biur — no bal yera'eh even break vessel — Pesachim 6a; challah d'rabbanan, chametz d'oraisa — d'oraisa nullification suffices; if minor kohen or immersed kohen, eat — see there.
457.mishnah-berurah/1:ז: (7) In basket — large basket bring together touching; if each has challah measure, Rama below: no basket needed, touching suffices; house combines without vessels; can separate one for another; if in vessels, bring vessels together open above [closed even close does not help] — when each has measure; if not each has measure, need combination — no leniency open close unless one basket or cloth cover — Biur Halacha.
457.mishnah-berurah/2:ב: (15) He may not bake it — no food need this baking; only if owner called name; another even if calls — no right to separate terumah. Servant in house — Yoreh De'ah 328 Acharonim.
457.mishnah-berurah/2:ג: (16) It becomes chametz — although holy not his — violates bal yera'eh since if he wishes redeems — becomes non-sacred.
457.turei-zahav/1:ב: Lest perhaps one of them, etc. Concern lest later obligated through combination and eats tevel — Rosh Beitzah 1 as nearby. Mahari Weil: seemingly our master basket helps even without touch; Yoreh De'ah 325 plainly basket combines; Semak requires touch; Tosafot Pesachim 46 s.v. heveil; Rosh challah agrees touch required. Our master abbreviated — Tosafot: in basket touch required for surrounding challah; Tur, Shulchan Aruch did not require touch — we hold not from surrounding 323; R' Yonatan Semag basket not combine — Peri Megadim uncertain; no stringent b'dieved — Semag lenient vessel air combines — Biur HaGra; study 325.
